content: With a bigger capital cushion, financial institutions may also be asked to do more to mobilize resources in capital markets, analysts say.

title: Japan's foreign reserves drop by a record $80 billion in August following yen intervention
summary: Japan's official foreign reserves fell by a record $80 billion in August to $1.207 trillion following government intervention to support the yen. The significant decline reflects the scale of currency market operations undertaken by Japan's finance ministry.
content: Finance ministry data showed that Japan's official foreign reserves stand at $1.207 trillion, down from July's figure of $1.287 trillion.
